values: Actuations target an ActuatableProperty such as Email and are triggered by ContextAwareRules over observations; an actuator executes only one actuation. Gateways and Groups modelled as sosa:Platform.
Observations subclassed per kind (TargetPosition, QualityObservation); quality observations take another observation as feature of interest. Procedures are individuals of a sosa:Procedure taxonomy.

ObservableProperty carries the data type of the observed value; each sensor observes one property and each actuator acts on one. Thing extends sosa:Platform; context-awareness rules trigger actuations.
A bridge cross-section is declared a sosa:Platform hosting the sensors installed on it. Observations produced by R2RML mappings and stored in HBase.
Built on the 2011 SSN with DUL: indicators are ssn:SensorOutput and scoring processes are ssn:Sensing with inputs and outputs. Observations satisfy goals expressed by benchmarks.
TBox only: SEAS energy forms beside sosa:ObservableProperty, ethic modes attached to ssn:System, devices linked to sensors by ioto:hasSensor.
Observations attached to stations by wep:madeByStation rather than to sensors; interval classes by duration reused for all observations. Qualitative values as SKOS collections of WMO codes.
The work mints its sensor, property, feature and observation IRIs in the sosa: namespace (sosa:se-0004). Rules over observations in LARS compiled to Flink.

Observations subclassed per theme (VulnerabilityObservation); survey and census data modelled as observations on regions or S2 cells. Integration relies on the spatiotemporal features rather than shared observable properties.
Monitored entities such as machines and patients are typed ssn:System and their sensors are subsystems. Properties are the items of a dashboard recommender.
ssn:hasSubSystem is reused as a generic part-whole relation between industrial entities and concepts generated from data-lake labels (385 links extracted).
The monitored battery cell is a host of its sensors rather than a feature of interest; no hasFeatureOfInterest shown. Anomaly causes derived by rules over pairs of observations.
SOSA is aligned by mapping: sosa:Observation made equivalent to lhr:EnvSSNResource, sosa:madeObservation to a subproperty of lhr:hasResource, sosa:resultTime to lhr:hasObservationDateTime.
Knowledge graph stored as a Neo4j property graph; observation subclassed per property kind (SpatialPositionObservation).
The motor is both platform and feature of interest of its consumption sensor; sensor thresholds (sn4e:maxValue) are stored on the sensor.
Built on the 2011 SSN: sbms:Observation is tied to a BMS data point and key classes carry IDs with owl:hasKey; observed properties split into physical quantity and property domain.
In the generated Jena rules sosa:Sensor is used as a predicate whose value is a sensor kind literal ('Pressure', 'PIR').
Sensor capabilities with SSN systems module (ssn-system:Range, ssn-system:Frequency) whose values use bop:hasSimpleResult; custom ranges inserted by SPARQL for outlier detection.
Feature of interest is a point IRI with lat/long query parameters; spatio-temporal values kept in a time-series database linked through madeBySensor.

The record subject <sosa/sensor/86338> is typed sosa:Weather_Station (a term not in SOSA) yet carries observedProperty and hasSimpleResult; all IRIs minted in the sosa namespace. Tweets modelled as social sensors observing a property.
Weather stations are subclasses of both geosparql:Feature and sosa:Platform; duration-specific interval classes reused for all observations.
Results linked to evidence resources (photos, videos, reports) and data segments; crack states model the temporal evolution of the feature.
One property individual is typed both sosa:ObservableProperty and sosa:ActuatableProperty; Web Things are typed sosa:Sensor or sosa:Actuator to support discovery queries.
Observations and observation collections aligned with an event ontology: collection members as sub-events, wasOriginatedBy as cause event.

Edge devices are sosa:Platform (written <http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa#Platform>), and ssn:Property is used for hardware resources and data volume/velocity/variety capabilities matched against task requirements.
Symbols of a learned timed automaton are typed sosa:Observation or sosa:Actuation; the work writes sosa:ActuableProperty, a term that does not exist.
Own ontology inspired by SOSA: devices point to observations by hasObservation, and the result (people count) is also copied onto the space entity.
Observations are event detections whose results are events, with the detection rule as sosa:Procedure; raw readings stay in InfluxDB and the model links each sensor to its InfluxDB instance.

System capabilities from S3N and the SSN systems module, with RAM and Flash as system properties carrying schema:value and schema:unitCode om:kilobyte; ML model inputs and outputs as subclasses of ssn:Input and ssn:Output.
Observations as blank nodes scoped per message; sosa:resultTime proposed as the version order of a message profile.
Observation, Sensor and Result each subclassed per climate factor (ca:[?]Observation). The work lists sosa:isMadeBySensor, a term that does not exist.
SOSA is mapped into a city information model by SWRL rules (sosa:Sensor(?x) -> cim:Sensor(?x)), and Brick points are linked to sosa:Observation.
Observable features are DUL roles that physical objects play according to sensor deployment; events (LowTemperature) derived by rules over observations, built on the 2011 SSN.
Process-mining event log entries are modelled as a subclass of sosa:Result with case, activity and timestamp attributes.
Properties are dereferenceable time-varying resources holding the current value; instances of sosa:ActuatableProperty are writable by agents. Brick aligned with SOSA/SSN.
giri:System is a subclass of sosa:System grouping ICT devices, power and cooling subsystems; observations feed sustainability metric instances, and capacities use qudt:QuantityValue.
The stream is an ssn:Output of a sensing; the observation is also a vsd:TimeVaryingGraph and event:Event. Example built on the 2011 SSN with SAO.
Station classes are subclasses of both sosa:Platform and geo:Feature, populated through a virtual knowledge graph over relational data.
Own relations (:isObservationFor, :isObservedPropertyFor, :isDataSourceFor) link hazards, observations, observed properties and data sources.
Measurements stored as (feature, property, time, value) tuples in a time-series database and mapped to SOSA observations on demand (Linked Time Series Data).
Services are mapped to sosa:Sensor and sosa:Actuator and compute-continuum nodes to sosa:Platform in the base TBox.
Observations carry key-value tags (<hasTags>, <keyTag>, <keyValue>) used to select time series for AI services.
ssn:Property is used for design parameters of HVAC components (nominal power, nominal efficiency), alongside BOT, PROPS and FSO.
OM classes are declared subtypes of sosa:Result.
ssn:hasProperty links objects of video scenes to their characteristics in a causal knowledge graph.
